description_good_justification: The README opens by stating what Imaguncula does: an offline desktop application and CLI that turns one SVG or PNG into correctly sized, named, and packaged icon assets. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula#readme
interact_justification: The README links to releases for obtaining the software, issues and Discussions for feedback, and CONTRIBUTING.md for contributing. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to report bugs, propose ideas, and submit pull requests. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the coding standards (rustfmt, clippy pedantic with -D warnings, Prettier, ESLint with zero warnings, SPDX headers, dependency policy) and the testing policy. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards
floss_license_justification: Dual-licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0, both FLOSS licenses. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/LICENSE
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT and Apache-2.0 are both OSI-approved licenses.
license_location_justification: LICENSE in the repository root states the dual license, with full texts in LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/LICENSE
documentation_basics_justification: The README covers installation and development setup, and the user guide covers basic use. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/docs/user-guide.md
documentation_interface_justification: The CLI is documented with a guide and a generated command reference, and the project file format is documented. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md
sites_https_justification: The project site, repository, and downloads are all served from GitHub over HTTPS.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues and GitHub Discussions are public, searchable, URL-addressable, and open to anyone. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/discussions
english_justification: All documentation is in English and bug reports in English are accepted.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: the first public beta, v1.0.0-beta.1, was released in November 2026 and development continues on main.
repo_public_justification: Public Git repository on GitHub. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula
repo_track_justification: Git records every change, who made it, and when.
repo_interim_justification: All interim work between releases is committed to the public main branch.
repo_distributed_justification: Git is a distributed version control system.
version_unique_justification: Every release has a unique Semantic Versioning identifier, recorded as a Git tag and a GitHub release.
version_semver_justification: Versions follow Semantic Versioning 2.0.0, for example 1.0.0-beta.1, as stated in CHANGELOG.md.
version_tags_justification: Each release is tagged in Git, for example v1.0.0-beta.1. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/tags
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md summarizes the changes in each release, and each GitHub release has human-readable notes. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: Each release's Security section in CHANGELOG.md lists fixed publicly known vulnerabilities with their identifiers, for example RUSTSEC-2026-0548 in 1.0.0-beta.1. No CVE has been assigned to Imaguncula itself. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through GitHub Issues using a structured bug report form; CONTRIBUTING.md explains what to include. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs
report_responses_justification: No bug reports have been received yet since the repository became public in November 2026. The documented policy is to acknowledge every bug report within seven days.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests have been received yet since the repository became public in November 2026; they will be answered in GitHub Issues and Discussions.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues provides a public, searchable archive of reports and responses. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md explains how to report vulnerabilities and what to include. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled and documented in SECURITY.md. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging vulnerability reports within seven days. No vulnerability reports have been received.
build_justification: The project builds with Cargo and pnpm, orchestrated by just (just build, just ci). https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/justfile
build_common_tools_justification: Builds use Cargo, pnpm, Vite, the Tauri CLI, and just.
build_floss_tools_justification: Every build tool (Rust, Cargo, Node.js, pnpm, Vite, Tauri, just) is FLOSS.
test_justification: Automated tests: Rust unit, integration, property, and CLI/GUI equivalence tests (cargo test), frontend unit tests (Vitest), and a desktop end-to-end and accessibility suite (WebdriverIO with axe). https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#testing-policy
test_invocation_justification: Tests run with the standard commands just test, cargo test --workspace, and pnpm test.
test_most_justification: Code coverage is not yet measured. Tests cover every preset output, validation and security limit, export path, and the CLI, but branch coverage has not been quantified.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs the full test suite on Windows, macOS, and Linux for every push and pull request. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires automated tests for all new functionality and a regression test for every bug fix. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#testing-policy
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes added tests with the functionality, for example the 1.0.0-beta.1 security fixes added regression tests such as failed_restore_preserves_the_previous_package_and_names_its_location in crates/imaguncula-core/src/export.rs.
tests_documented_added_justification: The testing policy is in CONTRIBUTING.md and the pull request template asks contributors to confirm tests were added. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md
warnings_justification: Compiler warnings plus clippy with the pedantic group, ESLint, svelte-check, and TypeScript are enabled. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/justfile
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any warning: clippy runs with -D warnings and ESLint with --max-warnings 0.
warnings_strict_justification: The workspace enables clippy::pedantic, forbids unsafe code, and treats all warnings as errors in CI.
crypto_published_justification: The only cryptographic algorithm used is SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4), for source content hashes.
crypto_call_justification: SHA-256 comes from the RustCrypto sha2 crate; the project implements no cryptographic functions itself.
crypto_floss_justification: The sha2 crate is FLOSS (MIT OR Apache-2.0).
crypto_keylength_justification: The software uses no cryptographic keys.
crypto_working_justification: Only SHA-256 is used; no broken algorithms such as MD5, SHA-1, or DES.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No algorithms or modes with known serious weaknesses are used.
crypto_pfs_justification: The software performs no network communication and implements no key agreement protocols.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The software has no user accounts and stores no passwords.
crypto_random_justification: The software generates no cryptographic keys or nonces.
delivery_mitm_justification: Releases are distributed only through GitHub Releases over HTTPS, with published SHA-256 checksum files. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/releases
delivery_unsigned_justification: Checksums are only published and retrieved over HTTPS. Dependencies are fetched over HTTPS and verified against lockfile hashes (Cargo.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml), and the tools CI downloads directly (Gitleaks, WingetCreate) are pinned by digest or SHA-256 hash.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No unpatched medium or higher vulnerability in the shipped software has been publicly known for more than 60 days. Remaining dependency alerts affect build and test tooling that is not shipped, or the glib VariantStrIter API (pulled in by Tauri's Linux GTK backend) that Imaguncula never calls.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Vulnerabilities are fixed promptly after being reported, for example RUSTSEC-2026-0548 was fixed by upgrading zip before the beta release.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The public repository contains no valid private credentials; Gitleaks scans the complete Git history in CI. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml
static_analysis_justification: Clippy (pedantic) and CodeQL run on every push and pull request, alongside cargo-deny, ESLint, svelte-check, and TypeScript. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/.github/workflows/rust-clippy.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security queries look for common vulnerability patterns, and cargo-deny checks dependencies against the RustSec advisory database.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: There are no open code scanning alerts; findings are fixed before release.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs on every push and pull request.
dynamic_analysis_justification: cargo-fuzz runs four fuzz targets (SVG preflight, relative paths, ICO and ICNS encoders) weekly and on every pull request that touches the core or fuzz code; property tests and a hostile-input corpus also run in CI. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/.github/workflows/fuzz.yml
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The software is written in memory-safe languages: Rust with unsafe code forbidden across the workspace, plus TypeScript.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Fuzzing and tests run debug builds with assertions and overflow checks enabled.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No unfixed vulnerabilities have been found by dynamic analysis.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: GitHub requires the owner to invite each collaborator explicitly; no access is granted by default.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: A repository ruleset on the default branch blocks deletion and force pushes.
osps_br_01_01_justification: Workflows pass inputs and event metadata through environment variables instead of expression expansion inside scripts, and no workflow uses pull_request_target. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/tree/main/.github/workflows
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull-request workflows run with read-only contents permission and no secrets; secrets are used only in the tag- and dispatch-triggered release and distribution workflows, and no workflow uses pull_request_target.
osps_br_03_01_justification: All official project URLs (repository, issues, Discussions, releases) use HTTPS.
osps_br_03_02_justification: Releases are distributed only through GitHub Releases over HTTPS with SHA-256 checksum files. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/releases
osps_br_07_01_justification: .gitignore excludes environment and local settings files, and Gitleaks scans the complete history in CI. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml
osps_do_01_01_justification: The user guide covers all basic functionality. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/docs/user-guide.md
osps_do_02_01_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to report defects, backed by a structured bug report form. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs
osps_gv_02_01_justification: GitHub Discussions and Issues are open for public discussion of proposed changes and usage problems. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/discussions
osps_le_02_01_justification: The source code is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, both OSI-approved.
osps_le_02_02_justification: Released assets are distributed under the same MIT OR Apache-2.0 license.
osps_le_03_01_justification: The license is in the repository's LICENSE file, with full texts in LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_03_02_justification: Each release includes the source code archives containing the license files, and the portable archive ships LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE.
osps_qa_01_01_justification: The repository is publicly readable at https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula
osps_qa_01_02_justification: Git history publicly records every change, its author, and its date.
osps_qa_02_01_justification: Direct dependencies are declared in Cargo.toml and package.json, with Cargo.lock and pnpm-lock.yaml committed.
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project consists of a single repository.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: No generated executable artifacts are committed; binaries are built in CI and published only as release assets.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The repository contains no unreviewable binaries; the only binary files are image assets and test fixtures.
osps_vm_02_01_justification: SECURITY.md identifies how to contact the maintainer privately about security issues. https://github.com/HusteDev/imaguncula/blob/main/SECURITY.md
